about: Furniture the architect drew, per level and flat. Written by blender/build_furnish.py from blender/plans/rooms.json. Frame: plan metres (CONTRACT.md). Files: <LEVEL>.glb in the same frame as web/interior/<LEVEL>.glb; nodes in_<LEVEL>_<owner>_furn_<kind><k>__<material>, origin = the piece's foot (footprint centre at the level's floor), so it can be scaled about its own origin.

fields.box: the drawn box: centre [x,y], size [across, along heading], heading (plan deg); axis_aligned boxes (corner glyphs) give size = [dx, dy]
fields.drawn: false = not on the sheet (sink, hob, and the dressing: plants, rugs, curtains, art...)
fields.order: reveal order within the flat: by room, drawn pieces first, then largest first
fields.nobox: an undrawn piece WITHOUT a box is not solid to a walking body (a rug, a curtain, a picture, a lamp, a table plant); a solid one carries its solid footprint as box
fields.z: the node origin's height over the level floor when it is not 0 (a plant on a table, a loggia pot on the loggia's raised floor)
